# Social Stream Ninja

Social Stream Ninja aggregates live social chat. The standalone desktop app is called SSApp.

## Local SSApp services

- Service chooser: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/local-services-guide.html
- Local WebSocket relay: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/local-websocket-server-guide.html
- Local Control API and MCP: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/llm-control-guide.html
- Headless home server or VPS: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/headless-server-guide.html
- Local Event Flow media: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/media-hosting-event-flow.html

## Local LLM control of the downloaded desktop app

- Setup guide: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/llm-control-guide.html
- Downloads: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/download.html#standalone
- Agent skill package: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/skills/control-social-stream.zip
- Agent skill instructions: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/skills/control-social-stream/SKILL.md
- Control API reference: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/skills/control-social-stream/references/control-api.md
- Compatibility log: https://socialstream.ninja/docs/skills/control-social-stream/references/version-log.md

SSApp 0.4.7 and newer can be launched as a local stdio MCP server with `--ssapp-mcp`.
Normal users should enable File > Local AI / Automation, restart SSApp, and choose Copy MCP
Setup. The copied configuration uses the installed application directly; it does not require
Node, Python, or a source checkout. MCP runtime capability discovery is authoritative.

The localhost `/api/v1` and MCP adapter are only for an AI process on the same computer as
SSApp. Remote users and Stream Deck use Social Stream's existing WebRTC or WebSocket session
transport instead.
